added.summary: HTML text tags map to the text element (<text> stays the core name); headings carry role heading with aria-level and HTML's type steps; inline formatting and <a href> style runs of one paragraph.
A link: a click sends a `link` event named by its href through the document's events (immediate and mounted), with a link node in the accessibility tree.
A generic box laid out by CSS display (block by default, flex, grid, none); landmarks take their roles (navigation, main, banner, contentinfo, complementary, article, region for a named section).

Non-virtual lists with CSS markers: list-style-type (none, disc, circle, square, decimal, lower/upper-alpha, lower/upper-roman), list-style-position, the list-style shorthand, <ol start reversed>, <li value>. Numbers come from the structural selectors' sibling index, so keyed reorders and inserts renumber.
A plain checkbox is a toggle; <label for=id> joins a checkbox as its caption and names any other control. A label with neither a wrapped checkbox nor for is refused.
